newsitem.title: USA: AMEX may halt trade in Centennial options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX may halt trade in Centennial options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said Friday it will halt trading in options on Centennial Technologies Inc on March 3 if the underlying stock does not trade on a national exchange or the Nasdaq stock market on Monday.

Centennial shares are currently listed on the New York Stock Exchange, but the NYSE has said it intends to suspend the shares prior to the opening on March 3 and will thereafter apply to federal regulators to delist them.
Centennial options trade on the Chicago Board Options Exchange and the AMEX.
